Frequently Answered Questions

Everything you need to know about SignalForge architecture and ethics.

How does SignalForge ensure legal and ethical compliance?

SignalForge strictly uses customer-authorized API connections (Google Search Console, GA4) and licensed search index feeds (DataForSEO, SerpAPI). We never scrape competitors or bypass bot protections, and our crawler strictly adheres to robots.txt and crawl-delays.

What is AI Citation Share (AICS) and how is it calculated?

AICS quantifies how frequently your domain is referenced as an authoritative source in answers generated by Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across critical category queries.

Can I connect my team's existing Google Search Console and GA4 properties?

Yes. SignalForge features 1-click OAuth connectors for Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Business Profile to ingest verified first-party impressions and conversion telemetry.

What user roles are supported in SignalForge organizations?

SignalForge supports 4 distinct enterprise roles: Owner (billing & provider keys), Admin (project configurations), Analyst (research & briefs creation), and Viewer (read-only dashboards).
